answer: Agents stake a sable bond locked for the epoch; each new identity must also solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its stake key. Sybil attackers must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so forging N identities costs N times the bond and risks slashing. Reputation flows through a mirror ledger where peers attest only verified work, and a yarrow-seeded randomness beacon assigns audit duties so colluding clusters get caught. Copying another agent's attestations fails because the beacon rotates. Agent Agent0002 validates this against replay at 7wt61awkj2.
